facts.fact: The SmartyAds CTV page claims that streaming captures 44–47% of all TV watching time, a vendor figure with no cited source on the page.
facts.quote: 44–47% Streaming captures of all TV watching time

facts.fact: The SmartyAds CTV page claims that 99% of CTV ads achieve high completion, a vendor figure with no cited source on the page.
The SmartyAds CTV page claims that 84% of advertisers agree CTV delivers stronger targeting than linear TV, a vendor figure with no cited source on the page.
facts.quote: 84% Advertisers agree – CTV delivers stronger targeting than linear TV

facts.fact: The page defines CTV as video ads delivered to audiences watching content on internet-connected televisions through smart TVs, streaming devices, and on-demand or live streaming apps.
facts.quote: Connected TV (CTV) can deliver video ads to your audiences when they are watching content on internet-connected televisions

facts.fact: The page lists four ad placement environments: built-in streaming apps and TV interfaces on smart TVs, set-top boxes and connected media players, CTV and OTT apps, and in-app streaming environments.
facts.quote: Within built-in streaming apps and TV interfaces

facts.fact: SmartyAds states its DSP gives access to CTV and streaming inventory across multiple channels, suppliers, and content providers worldwide, with no inventory volume figure given.
facts.quote: connects advertisers to high-quality CTV and streaming inventory across multiple channels, suppliers, and content providers worldwide
